messages:
laura: Quick sync — Zephyr offline registry rotation scheduled for TOMORROW 09:00 PST. We need clear owners and any last-minute blockers. TL;DR: signed images, mirror push, cert rotation, egress exceptions, and verification smoke tests.
ankit: I can own signed-image generation and the signing pipeline. PR pending: #5122 (adds cosign key rotation). pinging @kevin_se for review.
kevin_se: on it, will review this afternoon. heads-up: the cosign key in vault needs a policy tweak for the onprem service account.
matt_ops: Ops can run the mirror push and mirror-verification. need a runbook update for the airgap scoping (how we seed layers). I'll put a draft under runbooks/zephyr-offline.md.
cristina_security: Security note — the offline registry will use customer-provided CA cert; we need to confirm cert chain and CN SANs. Also audit log hooks must be wired. Who's got the cert sample?
laura: Zephyr sent a sample yesterday (ticket ZEP-1123). @matt_ops can you confirm location and whether it includes the intermediate?
matt_ops: confirmed. certs/zephyr/ contains leaf + intermediate + root.pem. however the customer cert uses an unusual SAN (service.zephyr.internal). we need DNS mapping during smoke.
sre_tim: Networking: firewall will need egress to our mirror endpoint on tcp/443 from their mirror-proxy host only. Also for cert-check we need outbound to letsencrypt/staging? we don't; they provide certs. Can we get a list of host IPs?
laura: customer provided a /29 and two static IPs: 10.4.1.12 and 10.4.1.13 (internal). We'll do NAT mapping in the runbook. @matt_ops can you confirm which source IP will connect to our mirror?
matt_ops: mirror push runs from their mirror-proxy (10.4.1.12). We'll document NAT translation and ephemeral port range.
ankit: note on signing: the signing job assumes the artifact layout from the build pipeline. If mirror reorders manifests, signature verification may fail. Suggest we run a local verification step post-push:
```
cosign verify --key k8s://projects/zephyr/cosign-key artifact:sha256:...
```
I'll add this to the job.
cristina_security: Also need to rotate the deployer cert on our side after the mirror is accepted — otherwise the long-lived cert is a risk. Propose a 24h short TTL and an automated shepherd job.
laura: Good call. Can we schedule cert rotation window + rollback? we should add to runbook.
kevin_se: reviewing PR now. small comment about error handling when cosign key fetch fails — prefer transient retries x3 with backoff.
registry-bot: Mirror job queued: zephyr-mirror-sync -> run id r-20250318-77 (scheduled 2025-03-18T09:00:00Z). Details: https://ci.internal/zephyr-mirror/r-20250318-77
matt_ops: ops checklist: 1) ensure cert chain loaded on mirror host; 2) confirm outbound NAT for 10.4.1.12; 3) pre-seed image list; 4) dry-run push to staging mirror. I'll run steps 1-2 tonight in staging.
sre_tim: networking change ticket created NET-4789. Assigning to @sre_tim for egress policy and @matt_ops for NAT docs. Please attach iptables/nft rules sample if needed.
laura: Ownership summary: signing = @ankit, PR review = @kevin_se, mirror ops + NAT = @matt_ops, firewall/egress = @sre_tim, security audit + cert TTL = @cristina_security. Anything missing?
kevin_se: add rollback owner for signature failures: I'll take rollback script and test path.
ankit: quick heads-up — I have one failing case locally where the manifest list uses an unfamiliar platform tag; will post details in PR comments.
cristina_security: if manifest includes unknown platforms, we should strip platform-specific indexes before signing or document allowed set. I'll coordinate with @ankit.
laura: final reminders: 08:00 PST tomorrow we do preflight (circle back if any blocker). Please post short status updates to this thread as you complete items. :thumbsup:
